high_level_description: This image depicts a statue of a person riding a horse, situated on a raised pedestal in an open area. The statue is made of a dark material, possibly bronze or black metal, and is mounted on a large, rectangular stone base with inscriptions that appear to be in Tamil script. The base is surrounded by a low wall. The setting appears to be an urban or semi-urban environment, as indicated by the presence of streetlights, utility poles, and power lines crisscrossing above. The area around the statue is grassy, with some patches of dry grass and small shrubs in the foreground.
